cases.query: How can search continue while a new index is being built?
cases.answer:
Build a new retrieval index in the background while serving queries from the old immutable snapshot. [60989c4b4aa290a5]

Publish the new version only after validation and durable metadata commit. [60989c4b4aa290a5]

Each query must capture one snapshot so ranks and text refer to the same version. [60989c4b4aa290a5]

cases.query: Why use reciprocal rank fusion instead of adding BM25 and cosine scores?
cases.answer:
Keyword retrieval handles exact service names and error codes. [dd30a1eaa2e89e3f]

Dense vector retrieval can capture latent relationships but may miss rare identifiers. [dd30a1eaa2e89e3f]

Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranked lists using the reciprocal of a constant plus rank. [dd30a1eaa2e89e3f]

cases.query: How do we avoid duplicate writes after a client timeout?
cases.answer:
Store the key, request fingerprint, and result atomically with the side effect. [fab7f88a1a01275a]

Reject key reuse with a different request. [fab7f88a1a01275a]

Define an expiration policy that covers the expected retry horizon. [fab7f88a1a01275a]
